title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
summary: Elizabeth Bennet, the sharp-witted second of five sisters, clashes with the proud and wealthy Mr. Darcy. Through first impressions, family scandal and second chances, both learn how pride and prejudice can blind the heart.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
summary: Bored on a riverbank, young Alice follows a White Rabbit down a rabbit-hole into Wonderland, a world of shrinking potions, a grinning Cheshire Cat, a mad tea-party and a Queen who shouts "Off with their heads!"

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
summary: Twelve cases solved by the brilliant detective Sherlock Holmes, told by his loyal friend Dr. Watson, from A Scandal in Bohemia to The Red-Headed League and The Speckled Band.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley
summary: Young scientist Victor Frankenstein builds a living creature from lifeless matter, then abandons it in horror. Rejected by everyone, the creature turns on its maker in this founding classic of science fiction.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
summary: Young lawyer Jonathan Harker travels to a crumbling castle in Transylvania to help a strange count buy a house in England. Soon a shadow follows him home, and a small band of friends must hunt the vampire before he claims them all.

title: The Time Machine
author: H. G. Wells
summary: A Victorian inventor rides his machine to the year 802,701 and finds the gentle Eloi living above ground and the frightening Morlocks below. Can he get back home before the future swallows him?

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
summary: Young Jim Hawkins finds a pirate's treasure map and sets sail for a far-off island, with a one-legged cook named Long John Silver who may be far more dangerous than he seems.

title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
author: L. Frank Baum
summary: A cyclone carries Dorothy and her dog Toto from Kansas to the magical Land of Oz. With a Scarecrow, a Tin Woodman and a Cowardly Lion, she follows the yellow brick road to ask the great Wizard for help.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
summary: In the glittering summer of 1922, Nick Carraway moves next door to the mysterious millionaire Jay Gatsby, whose wild parties hide one dream: winning back Daisy, the love he lost years ago.

title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
summary: Lonely, sulky Mary Lennox is sent to her uncle's gloomy house on the Yorkshire moors. There she finds a hidden key, a locked garden nobody has entered for ten years, and a secret that changes everyone.

title: Peter Pan
author: J. M. Barrie
summary: One night a boy who never grows up flies in through the nursery window and takes Wendy, John and Michael to Neverland, home of fairies, mermaids, Lost Boys and the villainous Captain Hook.

title: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
summary: Calm, precise Phileas Fogg bets his fortune that he can circle the globe in just eighty days. With his loyal servant Passepartout, and a detective on his tail, he races by train, steamer and even elephant.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
summary: A giant spectral hound is said to haunt the Baskerville family on the lonely moors of Dartmoor. When Sir Charles is found dead with terror on his face, Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson must protect the young heir before the legend strikes again.

title: The War of the Worlds
author: H. G. Wells
summary: A falling star lands on Horsell Common, and out of it climb the Martians. Towering three-legged machines march across England while one man struggles to survive and find his way home.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
summary: Orphaned and unloved, Jane Eyre grows up proud and independent. As governess at mysterious Thornfield Hall she falls for its brooding master, Mr. Rochester, but the house is hiding a terrible secret.
